metadata.description: Tihomir's Claude Code mods: CI watching, git state band, cache clock, next-step suggestions, delete guard with undo, line-ending guard, plan filing, session digests and a mod doctor.

plugins.name: ci-watch
plugins.description: After a git push, watches the GitHub Actions runs for that commit and reports pass or fail without you opening GitHub.

plugins.name: ship-bar
plugins.description: A band above the prompt with the repo's branch, changed files, unpushed commits and PR, plus Commit & push, Open PR and Diff buttons.

plugins.name: cache-clock
plugins.description: Shows above the prompt how long the prompt cache stays warm, the cache hit rate, context use and plan limits, with a compact button.

plugins.name: next-steps
plugins.description: After each turn, suggests three next prompts above the prompt box; type 1, 2 or 3 to send one. One small Haiku call per turn.

plugins.name: delete-guard
plugins.description: Holds recursive deletes, shows what would go, and offers move-to-trash with /undo-delete, delete, or refuse.

plugins.name: eol-guard
plugins.description: Keeps files' git line endings (CRLF/LF) after Claude's edits and shell commands, and stops prettier checks failing on a CRLF checkout.

plugins.name: plan-to-ticket
plugins.description: When you approve a plan, saves it as .claude/tickets/<ticket>/plan.md in the project and points Claude at that copy.

plugins.name: session-ref
plugins.description: When a prompt names an earlier session's ID, attaches a digest of that session (prompts, files, commits, last reply) for Claude.

plugins.name: mod-doctor
plugins.description: /mod-doctor checks every mod in one report: plugin mods loaded, settings hooks present, config valid, mods log errors.
